    'Developing - Primary': [75, 76, 74, 73, 75, 76, 77, 78, 77, 76, 75, 76, 77],
    'Developing - Secondary': [45, 46, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48, 49, 48, 47, 46, 47, 48],
    'Developing - Tertiary': [30, 31, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 34, 33, 32, 33, 34],
    'Underdeveloped - Primary': [60, 61, 59, 58, 60, 61, 62, 63, 62, 61, 60, 61, 62],
    'Underdeveloped - Secondary': [30, 31, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 33, 32, 31, 32, 33],
    'Underdeveloped - Tertiary': [15, 16, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 19, 18, 17, 18, 19]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars='Year', var_name='Group', value_name='GraduationRate')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
palette = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df_melted['Group'].unique()))

sns.lineplot(
    data=df_melted[df_melted['Group'] != 'Developed - Tertiary'],
    x='Year',
    y='GraduationRate',
    hue='Group',
    style='Group',
    markers=True,
    dashes=False,
    palette=palette,
    linewidth=2.5,
    legend=False
)

plt.title('Healthcare Access Trends by Development Status and Stage (2010-2022)', fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Graduation Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(df['Year'], fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)
plt.legend(title='Development Status - Education Stage', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300)
SUMMARY
 The image is a line chart titled "Education Graduation Trends by Development Status and Stage (2010-2022)," which illustrates the graduation rates across different education stages (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) in regions categorized by their development status (Developed, Emerging, Developing, and Underdeveloped) over a span of 13 years. The x-axis represents the years from 2010 to 2022, while the y-axis shows the graduation rates in percentage, ranging from 10% to 100%.

The chart features multiple colored lines and markers, each representing a specific combination of development status and education stage. The legend on the right specifies these combinations, with distinct colors and line styles for clarity. For Developed regions, the primary education graduation rates, shown in a light pink line, hover around 90-95%, demonstrating a consistently high performance over the years. Secondary education rates, represented by an orange line, range between 77% and 82%, while tertiary education rates, depicted in a brownish line, vary between 67% and 73%.

Emerging regions display primary education graduation rates in a greenish line, maintaining a range from 83% to 88%. Secondary education rates in these regions, marked by a darker green line, fall between 61% and 66%, and tertiary education rates, shown in a teal line, range from 49% to 55%. In Developing regions, primary education rates, indicated by a blue line, remain between 73% and 78%; secondary education rates, shown in a light blue line, range from 44% to 49%; and tertiary education rates, depicted by a purple line, vary from 29% to 34%.

Underdeveloped regions show the lowest graduation rates across all stages: primary education, represented by a bright pink line, ranges from 58% to 63%; secondary education, shown in a magenta line, varies between 29% and 34%; and tertiary education, depicted in a light purple line, ranges from 14% to 19%. The chart effectively highlights the disparities in education graduation rates across different development statuses and education stages over the observed period.

script = Path("chart.py").read_text()
script = script.replace("data=df_melted[df_melted['Group'] != 'Developed - Tertiary'],", "data=df_melted,")
script = script.replace("legend=False", "legend=True")
script = script.replace("Healthcare Access Trends by Development Status and Stage (2010-2022)", "Education Graduation Trends by Development Status and Stage (2010-2022)")
Path("chart.py").write_text(script)
exec(compile(script, "chart.py", "exec"))

ax = plt.gca()
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
print("Legend labels:", labels)
print("Y limits:", ax.get_ylim())
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
print("Table:\n", table.to_string(index=False))
print("Plotted series:", [(line.get_label(), len(line.get_xdata())) for line in ax.lines if len(line.get_xdata())])
